{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Stratify by severity and compute response rates within each stratum
def compute_stratified_effect(df):
    # Compute response rate within each severity group and arm
    strata = df.groupby(['severity', 'arm'])['responded'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()
    
    # Pivot to get response rates by severity and arm
    strata_pivot = strata.pivot(index='severity', columns='arm', values='mean')
    
    # Compute difference in proportions within each stratum
    strata_pivot['diff'] = strata_pivot['treatment'] - strata_pivot['control']
    
    # Compute weighted average difference (using control group counts per stratum as weights)
    control_counts = df[df['arm'] == 'control'].groupby('severity').size()
    total_control = control_counts.sum()
    weights = control_counts / total_control
    
    weighted_diff = (strata_pivot['diff'] * weights).sum()
    
    return strata_pivot, weighted_diff

# Run stratified analysis
strata_table, adjusted_effect = compute_stratified_effect(df)

# Print results
strata_table, adjusted_effect"}
